_doc: Degradation of clean DFL tracking toward Metrica automatic tracking. Each value is either a published fact (DATA.md/CHALLENGE.md) or a stated assumption; nothing is fitted to the target data or GT.
_ball_missing_frac: FACT DATA.md: ball present on 59.3% of graded frames (94,214/158,857) -> 0.407 missing. Base hazard is solved per sequence by bisection to hit it.
_ball_gap_mean_s: ASSUMPTION: DATA.md says missing 'in bursts' due to occlusions, crowded boxes, balls in the air; no length published. 1.5 s ~ duration of a duel/aerial ball.
_ball_bias: FACT (qualitative) DATA.md: 'occlusions, crowded boxes and balls in the air all lose it ... disproportionately on the frames that matter'. ASSUMED strengths: hazard x1.35 per player within 3 m (cap 6 -> x6), x4 if z>2 m, x2 if speed>20 m/s.
_drop_ball_z: FACT DATA.md/starter baseline: ATD ball rows are x,y,speed only; no height.
_player_missing_frac: FACT DATA.md: mean 20.5 tracked objects over graded frames for 22 players -> 1-20.5/22 = 0.068 (duplicates below add back ~0.01 object).
_player_gap_mean_s: ASSUMPTION: occlusion gaps ~2 s; no number published.
_slots_per_team: FACT DATA.md: 46 track slots for the match, each slot belongs to one team -> 23 per team. Tracklets get a random free slot (no identities).
_swap: FACT (qualitative) DATA.md: slots 'swap identity'. ASSUMPTION: when two same-team players come within 1 m, their continuations exchange slots with prob 0.3.
_dup: FACT (qualitative) DATA.md: count 'occasionally exceeds 22 when the tracker duplicates someone'. ASSUMPTION: 0.5 duplicate tracklets per team-minute, 0.5-3 s, offset N(0,0.7 m).
_jitter: ASSUMPTION: automatic tracking noise, none published; AR(1) rho 0.9 (smooth, not white, so velocities stay plausible), sigma 0.2 m players, 0.3 m ball.
